messages.japanese:
(1)麹に期待される効果
全ての人に同じ様に効果が出るとは言えませんが、研究発表されている効果です。
是非、麹を積極的に摂りましょう。
messages.english:
(1) Effects expected from koji
These are effects reported in research, although the same effects cannot be guaranteed for everyone.
By all means, make an effort to include koji in your diet.

messages.japanese:
1. 腸内環境改善(善玉菌の増加)
　　2. 免疫力アップ
　　3. アレルギー疾患の軽減
　　4.自己免疫疾患の抑制
　　5.便秘改善
messages.english:
1. Improved intestinal environment (increased beneficial bacteria)
2. Increased immunity
3. Reduced allergic disease
4. Suppression of autoimmune disease
5. Improved constipation

messages.japanese:
6.高血圧抑制効果
　　7.血糖値上昇抑制効果
　　8.消化促進効果
　　9.美白効果(シミの予防)
　 10.コレステロール、中性脂肪抑制効果
messages.english:
6. Suppression of high blood pressure
7. Suppression of rises in blood sugar
8. Improved digestion
9. Skin-brightening effects (prevention of dark spots)
10. Suppression of cholesterol and triglycerides

messages.japanese:
(2)いかに麹が調味料として優れているか。
代表的な調味料
甘味料…甘味を加えるもの(砂糖、みりん、甘麹など)
香辛料…香りや辛さを付けるもの(胡椒、七味唐辛子など)
旨味調味料…旨味を与えるもの(出汁、グルタミン酸ナトリウムなど)
messages.english:
(2) How koji excels as a seasoning
Representative types of seasonings
• Sweeteners…add sweetness (sugar, mirin, ama-koji, and others)
• Spices…add aroma or heat (pepper, shichimi chili blend, and others)
• Umami seasonings…provide umami (dashi, monosodium glutamate, and others)

messages.japanese:
他には醤油、ケチャップ、マヨネーズなど挙げればキリがない程xさまざまな調味料があります。
これらと比べて『塩麹』は、そのものの塩味、甘味は当然有りますが、1番の調味料としての
特徴は『素材そのものの美味しさを引き出す』という事です。
messages.english:
Other examples include soy sauce, ketchup, and mayonnaise; the range of seasonings is almost endless.
Compared with these, shio koji naturally has its own saltiness and sweetness, but its most important characteristic as a seasoning is that it brings out the deliciousness of the ingredients themselves.

messages.japanese:
元来私たちが食してきた和食は、四季折々の新鮮で豊富な食材そのものが持つ味を生かして
あまり味付けしないものです。
その和食に正にマッチした調味料が『塩麹』なのです。
messages.english:
Traditionally, the Japanese food we have eaten makes use of the natural flavors of fresh, abundant seasonal ingredients, without much added seasoning.
Shio koji is a seasoning that fits this style of Japanese cooking perfectly.

messages.japanese:
『塩麹』には麹から生成されたさまざまな酵素が豊富に含まれています。
アミラーゼによって食材のデンプンがブドウ糖に分解され優しい甘味を引き出します。
　デンプン分解酵素
messages.english:
Shio koji contains an abundance of various enzymes produced by koji.
Amylase breaks down the starch in ingredients into glucose, bringing out a gentle sweetness.
Starch-breaking enzyme

messages.japanese:
プロテアーゼによって食材のタンパク質がアミノ酸に分解され旨味を引き出します。
　タンパク質分解酵素
リパーゼによって脂肪を分解し香りを引き立たせます。
　脂肪分解酵素
messages.english:
Protease breaks down proteins in ingredients into amino acids, bringing out umami.
Protein-breaking enzyme
Lipase breaks down fat and enhances aroma.
Fat-breaking enzyme

messages.japanese:
セルラーゼによって食感を滑らかにしてくれます。
　細胞壁分解酵素
このように『塩麹』に含まれる酵素のさまざまな働きによって食材そのものの美味しさが
引き出されているのです。
messages.english:
Cellulase smooths the texture of food.
Cell-wall-breaking enzyme
In this way, the various actions of the enzymes in shio koji bring out the deliciousness of the ingredients themselves.

messages.japanese:
(3)塩麹作り方　　出来上がり～冷蔵庫　3ヶ月程　冷凍1年程
🔲 塩麹
□常温仕込み
塩麹は常温室温でゆっくり熟成(糖化)させていけば、酵素の活力は完全に保たれるので
料理に使う時、効果的に働かせる事が出来ます。
米麹200g ＋　塩　70g ＋　水　270cc
常温　7日～10日　　冬場は7日～14日位
messages.english:
(3) How to make shio koji — After completion: about three months refrigerated, about one year frozen
Shio koji
Room-temperature preparation
If shio koji is allowed to mature (saccharify) slowly at room temperature, the enzymes retain their full activity and can work effectively when used in cooking.
Rice koji 200 g + salt 70 g + water 270 cc
At room temperature: 7–10 days; in winter: around 7–14 days

messages.japanese:
□早造り熟成塩麹
上記常温熟成でも美味しいですが、かなり時間をかけても塩麹そのものの熟成度(旨味や甘味)を
あげることは困難です。早造りは短期間に熟成させ、尚且つ酵素も壊さずに、塩麹を作る最適な
熟成温度があります。
米麹200g ＋塩　70g ＋　水　270cc
発酵器　55℃ 約12時間
messages.english:
Quick-matured shio koji
Room-temperature maturation as described above is delicious, but even with considerable time, it is difficult to increase the maturity—the umami and sweetness—of the shio koji itself.
There is an optimal maturation temperature for making shio koji quickly, allowing it to mature in a short time without destroying the enzymes.
Rice koji 200 g + salt 70 g + water 270 cc
Fermenter: 55°C, about 12 hours

messages.japanese:
🔲 塩麹使い方例
《漬け床》
•肉、魚、野菜　何でも漬けられます。
3時間～　　　　漬けたまま冷凍保温しても良い。
◯例　　魚２切れ(200gくらい)に、塩麹大さじ2
魚や肉を良く洗い水気を拭き取り一晩ほど漬ける。
messages.english:
Examples of how to use shio koji
Marinade
• Meat, fish, vegetables—almost anything can be marinated.
From three hours onward. It can also be frozen while still in the marinade.
Example: two pieces of fish (about 200 g) with two tablespoons of shio koji
Wash fish or meat well, wipe off the moisture, and marinate for about one night.

messages.japanese:
《炒め物の素》
素材に火が通ったら最後に麹調味料を入れる。
＊素材に火が通る前に焦げやすいから。
messages.english:
Stir-fry seasoning
Add the koji seasoning at the end, after the ingredients are cooked through.
This is because it can burn easily before the ingredients cook through.

messages.japanese:
《スープ、汁もの》
麹をお湯で溶く、塩と同様に使う
＊煮過ぎると濃厚な味になる。
messages.english:
Soups and broths
Dissolve the koji in hot water and use it in the same way as salt.
Overcooking makes the flavor more concentrated.

messages.japanese:
《和え物》
基本分量　(あくまでも基本なので、ご自分の味にアレンジしてください)
素材　250g～300gに対し　塩麹大さじ1
messages.english:
Dressed dishes
Basic quantities (these are only a starting point, so adjust them to your own taste)
One tablespoon of shio koji for 250–300 g of ingredients

messages.japanese:
(4)変わり塩麹作り方
🔲 玉ねぎ麹　　　出来上がり～冷蔵庫2ヶ月　　冷凍半年程
玉ねぎ麹は初心者に使いやすい麹調味料です。玉ねぎの甘味があるので調理に使っても
塩っぱくなり難くいです。コンソメやブイオン代わりになります。
messages.english:
(4) How to make variations on shio koji
Onion koji — After completion: two months refrigerated, about half a year frozen
Onion koji is a koji seasoning that is easy for beginners to use. The sweetness of the onion makes it less likely to become overly salty in cooking.
It can be used instead of consommé or bouillon.

messages.japanese:
〈材料〉　　　　　　
•玉ねぎ　　　　　　　　300g
•麹　　　　　　　　　　100g
•塩　　　　　　　　　　 30g
messages.english:
Ingredients
• Onion: 300 g
• Koji: 100 g
• Salt: 30 g

messages.japanese:
〈作り方〉
①麹はほぐし、塩を合わせ、ムラの出来ないように良く合わせておく(塩切り)
messages.english:
Method
① Loosen the koji, add the salt, and mix well so that it is evenly distributed (shio-kiri).

messages.japanese:
②玉ねぎはすりおろす。①と②を合わせ、清潔な容器に入れて直射日光に当たらない場所で
　常温発酵させる。　かき混ぜる時は清潔な器具を使う事。
【春、秋…5～7日　　　夏…3～5日　　　冬…7～10日】
messages.english:
② Grate the onion. Combine ① and ②, put the mixture in a clean container, and ferment at room temperature in a place away from direct sunlight. Use a clean utensil when stirring.
Spring and autumn: 5–7 days; summer: 3–5 days; winter: 7–10 days

messages.japanese:
□熟成早造り玉ねぎ麹
発酵器　　　　40℃ 8時間　旨味強い。
　　　　　　　60℃ 6時間　甘味が強い。
messages.english:
Quick-matured onion koji
Fermenter: 40°C for eight hours gives a strong umami flavor.
60°C for six hours gives a strong sweetness.

messages.japanese:
🔲 玉ねぎ麹使い方例
《炒め物》
素材に火が通ったら、最後に玉ねぎ麹を加え軽く炒める。
messages.english:
Examples of how to use onion koji
Stir-fries
Once the ingredients are cooked through, add the onion koji at the end and stir-fry briefly.

messages.japanese:
《スープ》
例)ポタージュスープ
〈材料〉
•とうもろこし(コーン缶無塩) 200g
•豆乳(牛乳) 200cc
•玉ねぎ麹　　　　　　　　　　　大さじ1と1/2
messages.english:
Soup
Example: creamy corn soup
Ingredients
• Corn (unsalted canned corn): 200 g
• Soy milk (or milk): 200 cc
• Onion koji: 1½ tablespoons

messages.japanese: ○とうもろこし、玉ねぎ麹、豆乳を合わせ、ブレンダーやジューサーにかける。
messages.english: Combine the corn, onion koji, and soy milk, then process with a blender or juicer.

messages.japanese:
《ドレッシング》
例) 玉ねぎ麹ドレッシング
〈材料〉
•玉ねぎ麹　　　　　　　　　　大さじ4
•米油　　　　　　　　　　　　大さじ4
•酢　　　　　　　　　　　小さじ1～大さじ1/2
messages.english:
Dressing
Example: onion koji dressing
Ingredients
• Onion koji: four tablespoons
• Rice oil: four tablespoons
• Vinegar: one teaspoon to half a tablespoon
